blocks.text: Aga Muhlach and Charlene Gonzales threw their support to daughter Atasha Muhlach as she took center stage in the opening night of “Bongga Ka, ’Day!: The Annie Batungbakal Musical” on Friday, Sept. 18. The musical opened in Pasay City, with Aga and Gonzales among those who watched Atasha take on the titular role. During an ambush interview with the press, the proud parents expressed pride for their daughter. “Nakita ko kasi lahat ng hard work niya, ‘yung pinagdaanan niya… So it just warms my heart.
